newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM fuel cost study could affect cargo.
newsitem.headline: KLM fuel cost study could affect cargo.

text.p: A KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV study which is looking at the possibility of passing higher kerosene costs onto the airline's customers could embrace cargo clients as well as passengers, a KLM cargo spokesman said on Tuesday.
Maurits Kaalf told Reuters the study was looking at costs in general and was not just passenger-specific.
But he emphasised that no firm decisions had been taken by the airline.
Jet kerosene prices have increased by 20 percent since Iraqi troops entered Kurdish-controlled northern Iraq at the end of August.
KLM's response to the higher costs could be varied, Kaalf said.

"We could look at all other costs more critically, for example. The fact is we're still contemplating this and it is impossible to say what effect this will have on what part of the airline or what part of industry."
He added: "I don't see this simply in terms of higher passenger tariffs or higher cargo tariffs."
